title: Protocol for measuring NLRC4 inflammasome activation and pyroptosis in murine bone-marrow-derived macrophages
protocol: Streak S. Typhimurium on a Lennox Broth plate using aseptic technique.
Incubate the LB plate at 37°C for 16 hours.
Seal the LB plate with parafilm in the morning and store it at 4°C.
Pick one colony into 5 mL sterile LB broth.
Grow S. Typhimurium in an incubator at 37°C for 16 hours with shaking (200 rpm).
Sub-culture S. Typhimurium at a 1:100 ratio by adding 20 μL bacterial culture into 2 mL fresh LB broth.
Incubate the sub-cultured S. Typhimurium at 37°C for 4-6 hours with shaking (200 rpm).
Centrifuge the S. Typhimurium at 200 g for 3 minutes at 22°C.
Remove the supernatant and wash the S. Typhimurium pellet twice with sterile PBS.
Resuspend the S. Typhimurium pellet in 1 mL sterile PBS.
Measure the OD600 of the resuspended S. Typhimurium.
Aspirate off the BMDM culture medium from Petri dishes.
Add 5 mL sterile PBS to the Petri dish containing BMDMs.
Gently detach the BMDMs from the Petri dish by pipetting with a 1 mL pipette.
Count the cell numbers using a hemocytometer.
Seed 1.5×10^6 BMDMs per well in a 6-well plate with DMEM/F12 and supplements.
Culture BMDMs for 16 hours in a cell culture incubator.
Prime BMDMs with 0.5 μg/mL LPS dissolved in endotoxin-free water for 4 hours before S. Typhimurium infection.
Prime BMDMs with LPS for 4 h.
Wash the primed BMDMs 3 times with sterile PBS.
Change to FBS-free medium before infection.
Infect primed BMDMs with S. Typhimurium at an MOI of 10.
Collect 1 volume of supernatant into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube after infection.
Add ¼ volume of chloroform and 1 volume of methanol to the supernatant.
Flip the tubes to mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge at 13,800 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Aspirate off the top layer without disrupting the protein layer in the middle.
Add another 1 volume of methanol to the mixture.
Centrifuge at 13,800 g for 5 min at 22°C.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Air dry the visible protein pellet at the bottom of the tube for 5 minutes.
Boil the dried pellet in 1× Laemmli buffer.
Proceed with western blot analysis using SDS-PAGE and transfer procedures as specified.
Lysate cells with 200 μl TBS buffer for 30 min on a rocker at 4°C after infection.
Collect the lysed cells with cell scrapers.
Centrifuge at 6,000×g at 4°C for 15 min to obtain the Triton X-100 soluble fraction (lysate) as an ASC western blot loading control.
Wash the Triton X-100 insoluble fraction (pellet) twice with PBS (6,000×g at 4°C for 5 min).
Resuspend the pellet in 300 μl TBS buffer.
Break the pellet by vigorous pipetting and vortexing.
Add disuccinimidyl suberate to a final concentration of 4 mM.
Incubate in a water bath at 37°C for 30 min.
Vortex the tube periodically during incubation.
Centrifuge at 6,000×g for 15 min at 4°C after incubation.
Dissolve the pellet in 1× Laemmli buffer before subjecting to western blot.
Detect ASC specks by immunofluorescence staining.
Autoclave square-shape cover glasses before use.
Seed BMDMs at a density of 5 × 10^5 cells per well.
Infect the cells with S. Typhimurium as described above.
Move the cover glasses to new wells after infection.
Fix and permeabilize cells with 100% methanol at −20°C for 5 min.
Alternatively, fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS for 10 min at 22°C.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% TritonX-100 (in PBS) for 10 min at 22°C if using alternative method.
Wash the cells with PBS three times after fixation.
Incubate the cells with block buffer for 30 min at 22°C.
Dilute ASC antibody to a concentration of 2 μg/mL in PBST and incubate at 4°C for 10–16 h without shaking.
Wash the cells with PBS three times after antibody incubation.
Incubate the cells with goat anti-rabbit FITC secondary antibody (2 μg/mL) for 1 hour at 22°C in the dark.
Mount the cells using mounting medium containing DAPI (0.3 μg/mL).
Capture images using a fluorescent or confocal microscope.
Use the Zeiss LSM 510 Meta confocal microscope for imaging.
